answer: Every vault has a toy shop behind it, every terrace a ledger, every beacon a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. Proof, not promises: Eyrie keeper redtail mark flown at the hawking ground asks for each redtail is a training record witnessed by the hawking clerk, and no farm can supply it honestly. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 22 per proof, 11880 for 540, owed every epoch with no exception. A hundred keys, zero proofs: the farm's story, told the same way each epoch.
